title: Training Notes: Release of Plan Balances and Reinstatement of Defaulted Patient Payment Plans
content:
Patient Services Center training notes on what happens to the balance of a plan under the Patient Payment Plans when the plan ends early, and on reinstating a defaulted plan.

**Q. What happens to the remaining balance when a plan is cancelled, withdrawn or defaults?**
A. When a plan is cancelled by the patient, withdrawn or defaulted, its remaining balance is released back to the financial account's standard handling. After a cancellation or a withdrawal, and after a default on a tier whose defaulted balance does not go straight to the final notice, the released charges restart the statement series at 1. After a default on a tier whose defaulted balance goes straight to the final notice, the account goes straight to the final notice.

**Q. Who decides to cancel a plan?**
A. Cancelling is the patient's own decision.

**Q. When may a defaulted plan be reinstated?**
A. A defaulted plan may be reinstated where its reinstatement count is below the tier's allowed number of reinstatements, on payment of the tier's number of reinstatement installments. The reinstatement is made no later than the tier's reinstatement window counted from the date the plan defaulted. The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the default date, and a reinstatement on the last day still qualifies. The default date is read from the system record of the plan being reinstated.

**Q. What does reinstatement do?**
A. On reinstatement the released balance is re-enrolled, the installment is re-computed over the installments that remain of the original term, and any final notice issued because of the default is withdrawn by returning the account to active.

### Where the released balance goes

| How the plan ended | Released charges |
|---|---|
| Cancelled by the patient | Restart the statement series at 1 |
| Proposal withdrawn | Restart the statement series at 1 |
| Defaulted, tier not going straight to the final notice | Restart the statement series at 1 |
| Defaulted, tier going straight to the final notice | Account goes straight to the final notice |

### Reinstatement window boundary (hypothetical 30-day window)

A plan that defaulted on 10 July: day 1 of the window is 11 July and day 30 is 9 August. A reinstatement on 9 August qualifies; one on 10 August does not.

### Reinstatement count (hypothetical)

A plan on a tier allowing one reinstatement, already reinstated once, shows a count equal to the allowed number, not below it; it may not be reinstated again.
